title: DNS dashboard Nostr relay subscription substrate
observed_behavior: The DNS dashboard previously loaded DNS data through Svelte page/store REST reads and treated user refresh as a delivery mechanism.
intended_behavior: The DNS dashboard bootstraps DNS read models and DNS audit/drift events from Nostr relays with EOSE-authoritative catch-up, then remains live through scoped subscriptions. REST DNS data fetches and manual refresh delivery are not used.
